background: Serena K. Lipp is the Big Horn County clerk of district court and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The Lovell Chronicle reported that she ran unopposed after winning the Republican primary, and quoted her remarks at Gina Anderson's January 2026 retirement recognition.
